/* Bundled revision-225 Pix3D.java: gouraudTriangle 402-882,
 * gouraudRaster 885-1011. Generated by tools/port_pix3d_gouraud.py.
 * Triangle branches/edge updates retain Java names for review. */
#include "gfx/pix3d_gouraud225.h"
#include "gfx/pix3d.h"
#include "gfx/pix2d.h"

bool pix3d_jagged=true;

static int32_t jint(uint32_t v) {
    return v<=INT32_MAX?(int32_t)v:-1-(int32_t)(UINT32_MAX-v);
}
static int32_t jadd(int32_t a,int32_t b) { return jint((uint32_t)a+(uint32_t)b); }
static int32_t jsub(int32_t a,int32_t b) { return jint((uint32_t)a-(uint32_t)b); }
static int32_t jmul(int32_t a,int32_t b) { return jint((uint32_t)a*(uint32_t)b); }
static int32_t jshl(int32_t a,unsigned n) { return jint((uint32_t)a<<(n&31)); }
static int32_t jshr(int32_t a,unsigned n) {
    n&=31;
    if(n==0) return a;
    uint32_t v=(uint32_t)a>>n;
    return jint(a<0?v|(UINT32_MAX<<(32-n)):v);
}
static int32_t jdiv(int32_t a,int32_t b) {
    return a==INT32_MIN && b==-1?INT32_MIN:a/b;
}

/* Java's postincrement destination is evaluated before the RHS. Preserve
 * the neighboring destination read and separate source/background truncation. */
static void gouraud_write(uint32_t *dst,int32_t offset,uint32_t rgb) {
    if(pix3d_trans==0) { dst[offset]=rgb; return; }
    uint32_t alpha=(uint32_t)pix3d_trans,inv=256u-alpha;
    uint32_t src=(((rgb&0xFF00FFu)*inv>>8)&0xFF00FFu)
                 +(((rgb&0xFF00u)*inv>>8)&0xFF00u);
    uint32_t next=dst[offset+1];
    dst[offset]=src+(((next&0xFF00FFu)*alpha>>8)&0xFF00FFu)
                    +(((next&0xFF00u)*alpha>>8)&0xFF00u);
}

void pix3d225_gouraud_raster(uint32_t *dst,int32_t offset,
                            int32_t left,int32_t right,int32_t colourA,int32_t colourB) {
    int32_t step,groups;
    if(pix3d_jagged) {
        if(pix3d_hclip) {
            step=jsub(right,left)>3?jdiv(jsub(colourB,colourA),jsub(right,left)):0;
            if(right>pix2d_safe_width) right=pix2d_safe_width;
            if(left<0) { colourA=jsub(colourA,jmul(left,step)); left=0; }
            if(left>=right) return;
            offset+=left;
            groups=(right-left)>>2;
            step=jshl(step,2);
        } else if(left<right) {
            offset+=left;
            groups=(right-left)>>2;
            step=groups>0?jshr(jmul(jsub(colourB,colourA),pix3d_div_table[groups]),15):0;
        } else return;
        while(groups-- > 0) {
            uint32_t rgb=(uint32_t)pix3d_colour_table[jshr(colourA,8)];
            colourA=jadd(colourA,step);
            for(int i=0;i<4;i++,offset++) gouraud_write(dst,offset,rgb);
        }
        int tail=(right-left)&3;
        if(tail>0) {
            uint32_t rgb=(uint32_t)pix3d_colour_table[jshr(colourA,8)];
            while(tail-- > 0) gouraud_write(dst,offset++,rgb);
        }
    } else if(left<right) {
        step=jdiv(jsub(colourB,colourA),jsub(right,left));
        if(pix3d_hclip) {
            if(right>pix2d_safe_width) right=pix2d_safe_width;
            if(left<0) { colourA=jsub(colourA,jmul(left,step)); left=0; }
            if(left>=right) return;
        }
        offset+=left;
        for(int32_t i=left;i<right;i++,offset++) {
            uint32_t rgb=(uint32_t)pix3d_colour_table[jshr(colourA,8)];
            colourA=jadd(colourA,step);
            gouraud_write(dst,offset,rgb);
        }
    }
}
